## Outcome

Describe the user or maintainer problem and the result of this change.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No public contract change
- [ ] Backward-compatible addition
- [ ] Deprecation
- [ ] Behavior change
- [ ] Breaking change

Describe any impact on Java APIs, configuration properties, bean names, auto-configuration back-off, dependencies, Actuator behavior, or lifecycle behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] Unit or focused behavior tests added or updated
- [ ] Auto-configuration contract tests added or updated when applicable
- [ ] Integration or packaged-consumer tests added or updated when applicable
- [ ] `mvn --batch-mode verify` passes

List the commands and important results.

## Documentation and release notes

- [ ] User documentation updated, or not required
- [ ] Migration guidance added, or not required
- [ ] Release-note impact described, or not required

## Branches and backports

State the target branch and whether this change should be backported to `3.x`.

## Rollback

Describe how to disable or revert the change if it causes a downstream problem.
